_comment: Who this console belongs to. EDIT THIS FILE FIRST.
Read by the web app (titles, the agent's system prompt) and by the worker
(Canvas course mapping, Outlook/Gmail filters, outreach drafts), so
everything personal lives in one place. The values below are fake.
Your recruiting filter lives next door in lib/targets.json.
name: Alex Example
_courses_comment: Your timetabled courses. `code` is what the UI shows and what calendar titles are matched on. `canvasCode` is the course_code Canvas reports for your section (look it up with `npm run canvas:check`); it defaults to CODE-SECTION. `leadDays` is how many days before class prep should start.
_participation_comment: Optional. An .xlsx you keep by hand with a 'Class Log' tab (Date, Course, Spoke, Notes). Leave path empty to turn participation tracking off, or set PARTICIPATION_XLSX in .env.local instead.
_outreach_comment: How drafted outreach emails introduce you. Keep it to one clause.
